## Code Review — Quick Mode (Round 1)

Reviewers: cursor-structure (OK), codex-generic (OK), Claude-generic (OK). 3 of 7 slots produced valid output (4 Cursor slots failed with auth/config errors).

### Accepted Findings (Round 1)

1. **[correctness]** design/SKILL.md — Do NOT write `architecture-diagram.md` on non-architectural skip path; leave it absent so `write-design-manifest.sh` omits `ARCHITECTURE_DIAGRAM_FILE` and consumers render the standard "not available" fallback rather than a corrupted plain-text artifact. Fixed.
2. **[correctness]** implement/SKILL.md Step 7a — Bash snippet could yield `CHANGED_COUNT=0` on `git merge-base` failure (vacuous truth). Fixed: split into checked `MERGE_BASE` variable, use explicit `..HEAD` diff range, guard against count=0.
3. **[correctness]** implement/SKILL.md Step 7a — `.md` files in `skills/**`, `agents/**` are runtime SKILL/agent prompts, not docs. Fixed: classifier excludes `.md` files outside `docs/`; only `docs/**`, `.txt`, `.tsv`, `CHANGELOG` qualify as non-runtime.
4. **[code-quality]** design/SKILL.md — Missing "Otherwise (plan is architectural):" guard before generation block. Fixed.

### Round 1 summary: converged (all accepted findings non-substantial: 4 < 5, no high-severity class, < 60 LOC)
